meta.title: Costa Drinks — Drinks Home Delivery in Costa del Sol
meta.description: Order wine, beer and spirits delivered to your door in Marbella, Estepona and Benahavís. Sales until 22:00.

ageGate.heading: Age Verification
ageGate.body: You must be 18 or older to purchase alcohol in Spain. ID will be required at delivery.
ageGate.declineMessage: Sorry, you must be of legal drinking age to use this site.

saleWindow.openBody: You can order now. By law, home delivery of alcohol in Andalucía is only permitted between 08:00 and 22:00.
saleWindow.closedBody: Home delivery of alcohol is not permitted between 22:00 and 08:00 (Ley 4/1997, Andalucía). Please try again in the morning.
